decision: Use one new project activation entry and disable only the new user binding
reason: Keep the skill active once for the intended project while retaining native user cache/marketplace mechanics.

decision: Use native remove/re-add for the refresh control
reason: The pinned plugin CLI exposes add/remove; this is an allowed refresh alternative in Q8.
result: Source resource/version edit stays invisible before refresh; edited resource loads from a new native cache version afterward.

decision: Hold original profile bytes only in memory through admission and all controls
reason: This avoids the earlier Q7 hash-only restoration gap.
result: Measured bytes/mode restored exactly after verified owned-entry cleanup. The later Q7 notice-counter correction is a separate campaign cleanup.
